name: Sync Engine for Intercom – Sync Users, Orders & Events
author: RippleStep

sections.description:
Sync Engine for Intercom is an Intercom WordPress plugin that helps you connect Intercom to WordPress and sync WordPress users to Intercom automatically—along with WooCommerce orders, cart activity, tags, and custom attributes.

Stop guessing in Intercom. This WordPress Intercom integration keeps every WordPress and WooCommerce customer profile, order signal, and key event up to date—automatically—so your team can message the right people at the right time.

Install, connect your Intercom Access Token, and go live without custom Intercom API development for WordPress or expensive Zapier-style automations. Ideal for SaaS, membership sites, LMS platforms, and WooCommerce stores that need Intercom for WooCommerce and WordPress data to stay accurate.

What you get

  • Accurate customer profiles in Intercom — New signups and profile changes update Intercom contacts automatically (email, name, phone, avatar, roles, and custom fields).
  • Personalization that actually works — Segment and message by membership level, role, purchase history, and live site behavior—not last month’s CSV export.
  • Smarter support conversations — Agents see up-to-date customer context in Intercom because WordPress and WooCommerce data stays in sync.
  • Revenue and retention triggers — Send Intercom order events and Intercom cart events (including abandoned-cart signals) so you can recover carts, nurture buyers, and run post-purchase flows.
  • Less manual work, lower ops cost — No copy-paste syncs, no brittle one-off scripts. Background processing keeps large lists moving without slowing your site.
  • Reliable at scale — Built-in rate limiting, Action Scheduler queues, logging, and WooCommerce HPOS compatibility so syncs stay stable as you grow.

Demo Video

See how Sync Engine connects WordPress and WooCommerce to Intercom and keeps users, orders, and events in sync.

Intercom Integration for WordPress & WooCommerce

Sync Engine provides a complete Intercom Integration for WordPress & WooCommerce—also searched for as WordPress Intercom Sync, Intercom Sync for WordPress, or a WP Intercom connector. Connect once, then let Intercom stay current as customers register, buy, update profiles, and engage on your site. See our WordPress Intercom Integration overview for details.

Whether you run a membership site, LMS, WooCommerce store, or SaaS on WordPress, you get a durable Intercom API WordPress connection that turns site activity into usable Intercom data—in real time. Use it to sync WooCommerce customers to Intercom, send WordPress events to Intercom, and keep Intercom contact sync accurate without building a custom integration.

Outcomes by audience

  • WooCommerce stores — Know who bought what, when they abandoned a cart, and their lifetime value inside Intercom. Power recovery and upsell messages with live purchase data via full WooCommerce Intercom Integration.
  • Membership & SaaS — Membership Intercom sync keeps plan/role changes up to date the moment they happen so billing, onboarding, and churn prevention messages stay relevant.
  • LMS platforms — Push enrollments, progress signals, and student attributes into Intercom to coach learners and reduce drop-off.
  • Support & success teams — Open Intercom with current WordPress context—no tab-hopping to the admin to verify a customer’s status.
  • Marketers — Build Intercom segments and campaigns on fresh tags, attributes, and events from WordPress—not outdated lists.

Why teams switch to Sync Engine

  • Replace manual syncing — Contacts and attributes update when WordPress data changes. No more exports or forgotten updates.
  • Replace fragile automation stacks — Dedicated WordPress ↔ Intercom sync for users, events, tags, and WooCommerce data—without stitching five tools together.
  • Run Intercom on truth — Events (registration, login, orders, cart, custom milestones) arrive in Intercom so automations fire on real behavior.
  • Stay fast under load — Syncs run in the background; rate limits respect Intercom’s API; logs make issues easy to diagnose.
  • Extend when you need to — Hooks, filters, and a custom event API for developers who need edge-case control.

Key Features

Sync WordPress Users to Intercom | WordPress Intercom User Sync

  • Automatically sync WordPress users to Intercom on registration
  • Update Intercom when WordPress user updates occur
  • Sync email, name, phone, avatar, and custom attributes
  • Map WordPress user roles to Intercom segments
  • Select which user roles to sync
  • Background processing for large user bases
  • Real-time sync for immediate updates

Send WordPress Events to Intercom | WordPress Intercom Events

  • Track WordPress user events (registration, login, logout, profile updates)
  • Send WordPress events to Intercom automatically
  • WooCommerce event tracking (orders, cart, purchases)
  • Custom event support for any WordPress action
  • Event metadata and custom properties
  • Enable/disable individual events
  • Event prefix customization

Sync WordPress Tags to Intercom

Automatically apply tags in Intercom based on WordPress roles, user activity, purchases, and custom attributes. Use tags to create targeted Intercom segments and personalized messaging.

Intercom API WordPress Integration

  • Secure Intercom API connection
  • Access token and workspace ID configuration
  • Automatic contact creation and updates
  • Find contacts by email
  • Update existing Intercom contacts
  • Error handling and retry logic
  • Comprehensive logging

WooCommerce Intercom Integration

  • Sync WooCommerce customers to Intercom
  • Sync WooCommerce orders to Intercom with order status events
  • Monitor cart activity and abandoned cart Intercom signals
  • Send purchase data to Intercom
  • Customer lifetime value tracking
  • Product and order metadata sync

Intercom Custom Attributes & Metadata

  • Map WordPress user metadata to Intercom custom attributes
  • Sync custom fields to Intercom
  • Update Intercom custom attributes when WordPress data changes
  • Support for any WordPress user meta field
  • Flexible field mapping

User Segmentation & Tagging

  • Automatically tag users in Intercom based on WordPress roles—use Intercom tags from WordPress roles and membership data
  • Create segments from WordPress user data
  • Sync membership levels and subscription status
  • Track user activity and engagement
  • Build targeted Intercom segments for better Intercom segmentation

Developer Features

  • Extensive WordPress hooks and filters
  • Custom event tracking API
  • Modify event data before sending
  • Prevent events from being sent
  • Register custom event hooks
  • Action scheduler integration
  • Comprehensive logging system

Use Cases

  • E-commerce — Recover abandoned carts, trigger post-purchase messages, and segment VIPs using live WooCommerce orders and customer data in Intercom.
  • Membership — Welcome new members, message renewals, and pause outreach for cancelled plans using role and membership sync.
  • LMS — Nudge inactive students and celebrate completions with Intercom flows driven by WordPress events and attributes.
  • SaaS on WordPress — Keep product-led Intercom journeys aligned with signups, logins, and subscription-related profile changes.
  • Content & community — Engage readers and members based on real activity events—not static mailing lists.
  • Any WordPress site using Intercom — Get users, tags, attributes, and events into Intercom without building a custom integration.

Installation

Step 1: Install the Plugin

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Sync Engine for Intercom”, “WordPress Intercom integration”, “Intercom WooCommerce”, or “sync WordPress users to Intercom”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Alternatively, upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sync-engine-for-intercom/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.

Step 2: Connect to Intercom API

  1. Go to Intercom Sync in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Navigate to the Connection page
  3. Get your Intercom Access Token from your Intercom workspace:
    • Go to Settings → Developers → Developer Hub in Intercom
    • Create a new app or use an existing one
    • Copy your Access Token
  4. Enter your Intercom Access Token and Workspace ID
  5. Click “Save Connection” to test the connection

Step 3: Configure User Sync

  1. Go to Intercom Sync → User Sync
  2. Enable “User Sync” toggle
  3. Select which WordPress user roles to sync to Intercom
  4. Choose which user data fields to sync (email, name, phone, avatar, etc.)
  5. Click “Save Settings”

Your WordPress users will now automatically sync to Intercom when they register or update their profiles.

Step 4: Configure Events

  1. Go to Intercom Sync → Events
  2. Enable the WordPress events you want to track:
    • User Registration
    • User Login
    • User Logout
    • Profile Updates
    • WooCommerce Order Events (if WooCommerce is installed)
    • Cart Events
  3. Configure event prefixes if needed
  4. Events will automatically sync to Intercom

Step 5: Test the Integration

  1. Create a test WordPress user or update an existing user profile
  2. Check your Intercom workspace to verify the contact was created/updated
  3. Perform a test action (login, order, etc.) and verify the event appears in Intercom
  4. Review the Logs page for any sync issues

Frequently Asked Questions

What changes after I install this?

Before: Intercom contacts go stale. New signups, profile edits, and WooCommerce orders often never reach Intercom—or only get there after CSV exports, Zapier recipes, or custom code. Support and marketing work from incomplete customer context.

After: Connect your Intercom Access Token once. WordPress users, attributes, tags, and key events (including WooCommerce orders and cart activity) sync automatically in the background. Intercom stays current, so segments, messages, and support conversations can run on live site data instead of outdated lists.

How do I connect Intercom to WordPress?

Install the Sync Engine for Intercom plugin, go to Intercom Sync → Connection, and enter your Intercom Access Token and Workspace ID. The plugin will automatically connect to the Intercom API and start syncing your WordPress users.

How do I connect Intercom to WordPress without Zapier?

You don’t need Zapier. Install this Intercom WordPress plugin, paste your Intercom Access Token, choose which roles and events to sync, and Sync Engine handles WordPress to Intercom sync for users, attributes, tags, and WooCommerce data in the background.

How do I sync WooCommerce orders to Intercom?

Enable WooCommerce order and cart events under Intercom Sync → Events. When customers place or complete orders, Sync Engine sends Intercom order events and related purchase data so you can sync WooCommerce orders to Intercom for segments, recovery flows, and post-purchase messaging.

Can I sync WordPress user roles and tags to Intercom?

Yes. Select which WordPress roles to sync, map attributes, and automatically apply Intercom tags based on roles, membership, purchases, and activity—so Intercom segmentation stays aligned with your WordPress user data.

Does this plugin sync WordPress users to Intercom automatically?

Yes! Once configured, the plugin automatically syncs WordPress users to Intercom when they register or update their profiles. You can select which user roles to sync and which data fields to include.

Can I send WordPress events to Intercom?

Absolutely. The plugin tracks WordPress events (user registration, login, profile updates) and WooCommerce events (orders, cart activity) and automatically sends them to Intercom. You can also track custom events using the provided API.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, Sync Engine is free to use. Advanced features are offered in premium version. For support or questions, use our contact form.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin includes full WooCommerce Intercom Integration. It syncs WooCommerce customers to Intercom, tracks Intercom order events, monitors cart activity and abandoned cart Intercom signals, and sends purchase data to Intercom for segmentation and automation.

How do I sync custom WordPress user metadata to Intercom?

The plugin automatically maps WordPress user metadata to Intercom custom attributes. Any WordPress user meta fields are synced to Intercom, allowing you to use WordPress data in Intercom segments and workflows.

Can I update Intercom when WordPress user updates occur?

Yes, the plugin automatically updates Intercom user profiles whenever WordPress user data changes. This includes profile updates, role changes, and metadata modifications.

Does this plugin support custom events?

Yes, you can track custom WordPress events and send them to Intercom using the track_custom_event() method. This allows you to track any user action or milestone you want to monitor in Intercom.

How do I track WordPress Intercom KPIs?

The plugin sends WordPress events and user data to Intercom, which you can then use to track KPIs in Intercom’s analytics. This includes user registrations, engagement, purchases, and custom metrics.

Will this slow down my WordPress site?

No, the plugin uses WordPress Action Scheduler for background processing. All syncs happen in the background, so they won’t impact your site’s performance.

Can I use this with membership plugins?

Yes, the plugin works with all WordPress membership plugins, LMS platforms, and user management systems. It syncs WordPress users regardless of how they’re managed.

How do I segment users in Intercom based on WordPress data?

The plugin automatically syncs WordPress user roles, metadata, and custom attributes to Intercom. You can then use this data in Intercom to create segments based on WordPress roles, membership levels, purchase history, and any custom fields.

What WordPress events are tracked?

The plugin tracks user registration, login, logout, profile updates, WooCommerce order creation, order completion, cart item additions, and any custom events you define.

Can I prevent certain events from being sent to Intercom?

Yes, you can disable individual events in the Events settings page, or use the rpplstp_iws_should_send_event filter to programmatically prevent events from being sent.

  2. Sync WordPress users to Intercom
  3. WooCommerce customer and revenue sync with Intercom
  4. Send WordPress and WooCommerce events to Intercom

  • Synchronized plugin version metadata.

  • Async Role Tag Added
  • HPOS Compatiblity
  • Reduced API Calls for User Sync And Event Sync
  • Used Rate Limiting along With Instant Async Call

1.0.3

  • Initial release
  • WordPress Intercom user sync functionality
  • Automatic profile updates when WordPress user data changes
  • WordPress event tracking and syncing to Intercom
  • WooCommerce Intercom integration
  • Custom event support
  • Metadata and custom attributes sync
  • User segmentation and tagging
  • Background processing with Action Scheduler
  • Rate limiting for Intercom API compliance
  • Comprehensive logging system
  • Developer hooks and filters

Upgrade Notice

1.0.3

Initial release of Sync Engine for Intercom. Install to start syncing WordPress users and events to Intercom.
